status: proposed migration inventory; no feature implementation approved

items.title: Branding, app identity, storage and release isolation
items.status: Shipped identity; native isolation not implemented
items.native: Native startup, packaging, update and desktop-preference services exist, but use MonoCode identity and production-data defaults.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR names/assets, app IDs, molfar.db, configuration namespaces, protocols, notification/keyring identity, CLI credentials and independent update feed. Migration identity must also differ from current production MOLFAR.
items.portability: Adapt existing native identity/startup/packaging; preserve historical identifiers only inside explicit import mappings. Do not globally rename the dependency tree or wire contracts.
items.dependencies: G0 build boundary; before any real native startup, scheduler or listener.
items.risks: An explicit database override alone does not isolate preferences, tokens, roster, logs, notifications or updater. Release defaults can select installed MonoCode data.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose one explicit migration identity/data policy and fail-closed startup path validation; disable installed-profile auto-discovery, schedulers and network listeners for migration profiles.
acceptance: Migration app ID, paths, update channel and credentials differ from both production apps on every supported OS.
Test default/explicit DB/CLI/packaged modes; missing or corrupt copied data produces recovery state and never production fallback.
Hash original fixture sources before/after import; original database, sidecars, preferences and agent files remain unchanged.

items.title: Provider, sessions, streaming, tools and remote-host contracts
items.status: Common native functionality with shipped MOLFAR extensions
items.native: Eleven provider transports, normalized native events, accounts, worker runtime, transcript and store already exist; Node remote host remains separate.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR custom session/card/Familiar/worktree metadata, queued-message policies, app access and pending hardening invariants. Provider selection/catalog/ordinary chat are common, not new features.
items.portability: Prefer native transports/reducers and reuse TS tests as protocol fixtures; explicitly map string session IDs to native handles without losing original durable identity. Keep host wire compatibility; no wholesale JS sidecar proposed.
items.dependencies: M01, copied-data schema/provenance map, current capabilities.
items.risks: Different row/block representations; stale callbacks/account switch results; unsupported provider capability silently dropped; transient failure interpreted as empty history.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose compact state updates and worker IO using existing native runtime; stable row IDs, scroll anchors and explicit unavailable/auth/retry states. Measure fixed workloads before claiming a speed gain.
acceptance: Replay text/reasoning/tool/approval/question/usage/failure/cancel fixtures with matching order and terminal state.
Saved history, custom fields, queue ownership and turn provenance survive copied-data reload and round-trip.
Stop/account-switch/close during streaming cannot mutate another session or leave a provider child alive; stale responses discarded.
Keyboard transcript selection/focus and reader position survive incremental updates; empty/catalog/auth/network errors are distinct.

items.title: PTY, terminal, Git and worktrees
items.status: Common native capability; pending hardening policies
items.native: Native Alacritty terminal, Git/SCM and worktree services already implemented, including last-panel terminal preservation.
items.uniqueDelta: Reconcile MOLFAR PTY ownership/replay budgets and Git environment hardening, remote validation and safe deletion/retained-worktree policy. xterm UI is not a portability target.
items.portability: Adapt small Rust algorithms and contracts into native owners. Transfer hardening regression cases rather than Tauri wrappers or directory splits.
items.dependencies: M01/M02; Board later consumes these services.
items.risks: Inherited GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE redirects commands; delete/force-remove risks uncommitted work; Unix foreground signaling does not prove Windows stop behavior.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose stable terminal entity ownership, clear job-versus-shell close choices and bounded replay; one explicit repository command policy where existing code needs it.
acceptance: Environment-poisoned fixture operates only on intended repository; unknown remote rejected.
Terminal resize/reconnect/hide/show preserves shell and scrollback; cancel-close preserves job; Unix and Windows tested separately.
Worktree deletion makes dirty/unpushed state visible and requires explicit destructive choice; main checkout and retained branch remain intact.
Git failures display actionable error instead of incomplete success; keyboard terminal escape/focus works.

items.title: Familiar multi-project sessions and identity mapping
items.status: Shipped; substantial common native equivalent
items.native: Native Mono roster already has projects, session association, sidebar flags, documents, launches, outbox and pending reports; native Mono split panes already exist.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR Familiar presentation, roster key molfar:familiar-roster, directories, saved IDs and project/path policy. Multi-project support itself is not uniquely ours.
items.portability: Reuse native Mono model and views; add explicit copied-roster/session mapping and focused policy adaptations. Do not port React overlay design over native split panes.
items.dependencies: M01/M02; preference import, original-ID mapping.
items.risks: Duplicate Familiar, missing associations silently opening a new session, removed project deleting persistent context.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose visible unavailable-association repair, stable focus/selection and accessible project chips using native controls.
acceptance: Copied roster order/labels/projects and associated session identity match source; duplicate path aliases collapse consistently.
Project removal does not delete Familiar files or conversation; missing project/session stays visible without implicit replacement.
Empty/create/remove flows are keyboard operable; project switch does not jump focus or reset draft.

items.title: Soul, memory, topic files, redaction and conflict protection
items.status: Shipped; mostly common native equivalent
items.native: Native files/memory services already implement app-owned files, locking, dated entries, redaction and 200-line/24KiB prompt budget.
items.uniqueDelta: Map familiars versus monos storage, exact existing file content, history/archive/search and MOLFAR scope policies. Markdown and JSON formats are portable.
items.portability: Reuse native file/memory services after fixture reconciliation; import copied files with explicit manifest; no automatic production adoption.
items.dependencies: M01/M04 and app authorization M11.
items.risks: Lost updates, path escape, redaction mismatch, truncating durable files to prompt budget.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose conflict UI that preserves unsaved text and offers explicit compare/reload; separate prompt truncation from durable storage.
acceptance: SOUL/MEMORY/topic/archive fixture bytes preserved; budget applies only to context inclusion.
Stale hash, invalid path and concurrent write reject without lost update; missing optional files and corrupt JSON have explicit states.
Redaction/search/supersede/archive fixtures match; secrets never enter logs; conflict recovery remains keyboard accessible.

items.title: Habits, scheduler, hidden sessions and approval relay
items.status: Shipped; native equivalent needs behavioral reconciliation
items.native: Native habit schedule/claim/history policy and GPUI scheduler already exist.
items.uniqueDelta: Confirm MOLFAR timeout, no-duplicate claim, hidden-session launch, approval relay and artifact/report delivery semantics against native implementation.
items.portability: Reuse native scheduler; port only differing policy and test fixtures, not React effects.
items.dependencies: M02/M04/M05/M11/M18; scheduler enablement only after copied-profile review.
items.risks: Imported schedule runs unexpectedly; two owners execute same claim; stale approval resumes stopped task.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose paused imported schedules for migration testing, explicit next-run/timezone/status and recoverable failure history.
acceptance: Hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly/DST fixtures match; disabled habits never execute.
Concurrent claim yields one run; cancellation/timeout/deny records correct history and cannot relaunch after STOP.
Pending approval remains paused; restart cannot duplicate completion/card delivery; empty/invalid schedule UI explains recovery.

items.title: Grouped Familiar completion reports
items.status: Shipped; common feature with different algorithms
items.native: Native host already groups launches by origin_turn and waits before reporting.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR accepted/rejected launch, settlement callback, stale retry, dismissal and per-Familiar/turn batching guarantees need explicit comparison.
items.portability: Reuse native completion mechanism; port missing invariants as focused native regressions.
items.dependencies: M02/M04/M06/M11 and artifact cards M18.
items.risks: Fast child causes early partial report; later source turn receives old report; duplicate/stale callbacks or busy Familiar cause unintended steering.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose one stable consolidated report/card, queued while busy, preserving reader position and all child outcomes. Durable completion-group recovery after restart is an additional proposal; shipped TS batching is in-memory.
acceptance: Fast completion before sibling registration still waits; rejected launch excluded; failure/cancel terminal; stale retry ignored.
Same session watched by different Familiar/turn does not cross-deliver; dismissal removes only intended result.

Baseline parity: one report per accepted batch while owned; busy Familiar queues instead of steering; report navigation preserves scroll/focus. Proposed additional durability criterion, requiring slice approval: restart recovers accepted group metadata without duplicate delivery.

items.title: Task Board durable stage engine and recovery
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific functionality
items.native: Native orchestration handles scoped dependency plans; no equivalent durable Board engine/store found.
items.uniqueDelta: Persisted cards/runs/settings, serialized claims, dispatch receipts, reconciliation, hidden card sessions and exactly-once settlement.
items.portability: Reuse Rust schema/DB routines after version checks; port TS state machine into a focused core Board service with injected session/git/time/store boundaries. Native UI observes committed state.
items.dependencies: M01/M02/M03/M11/M18; cancellation/settlement contract first.
items.risks: Double dispatch after crash, lost final text after detachment, queued task restarting after user STOP, stale live claim.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose durable transition receipts and event-driven projections; visible interrupted/needs-input states instead of optimistic success. Persisting a global engine pause across restart is an additional proposal; shipped engine STOP uses an in-memory flag.
acceptance: Full fixture flow traverses existing stages; crash at accepted/session_prepared/turn_submitted/settled recovers without double run.
Duplicate callback settles once with full final text; unavailable runtime becomes interrupted, never false success.

Preserve existing card cancellation and review-gate behavior on reload; cancelled cards cannot silently redispatch. Proposed additional global-pause durability across restart requires slice approval. DB work stays off UI thread; empty/loading/error board states recover explicitly.

items.title: Board per-stage models, skills and review gates
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific policy
items.native: Native model/catalog/skill and approval controls exist, but no Board column/stage inheritance policy or Board review gates.
items.uniqueDelta: Per-stage overrides and column defaults, frozen run provenance, explicit plan/final gates and existing legal transition policy.
items.portability: Reuse native catalog/capabilities; port resolution and transition rules with fixtures into Board domain. Do not duplicate provider model controls.
items.dependencies: M08/M02 and copied Board settings.
items.risks: Old model ID silently substituted; incompatible effort survives provider change; editing defaults changes historical provenance; gate bypass.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose clear inherited/overridden/effective setting display and actionable missing-model/skill states.
acceptance: Override precedence matches source; provider switch clears incompatible fields; existing run provenance remains immutable.
Unavailable model blocks launch visibly; missing skills handled explicitly; plan approval and final gate cannot be skipped.
Keyboard settings/review controls labeled; empty catalog and stale approval show useful error without dispatch.

items.title: Board worktrees, versioned artifacts and file handoff
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific workflow
items.native: Native Git/worktree/checkpoint and generic artifact services exist; no equivalent Board stage file-handoff contract.
items.uniqueDelta: Retained worktree/fixed base, required artifact version references under ignored .molfar/board, stage fingerprints, legal action checks, gate/delivery races.
items.portability: Adapt native worktree service; preserve Board artifact store and provenance in core; pass file paths to stage prompts rather than copying artifact bodies.
items.risks: Dirty main overwritten; stale artifact version used; startup cancellation misses newly created session; duplicate final delivery.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose visible artifact prerequisites/version history and cancellation acknowledgment, with transition preconditions checked before filesystem writes.
acceptance: Main checkout untouched; retained worktree reused without dropping dirty files; missing artifact blocks launch.
Selected versions/fingerprints match run receipt; prompt references existing input files, not expanded bodies.
Cancel during startup stops newly created session; duplicate delivery rejected; failed handoff retains evidence and offers explicit retry.

items.title: App CLI, connector MCP, action authorization, idempotency and STOP
items.status: Shipped base plus pending hardening; native common actions
items.native: Native bridge, request IDs, auth, inflight/receipt handling and most common Mono actions already exist.
items.uniqueDelta: 37-action MOLFAR app surface including Board/Confluence; distinguish control task namespace from app actions. Preserve scope, read/hash-before-write, effect/receipt atomicity and paused read-only behavior.
items.portability: Extend native validation/action services at domain boundaries; port only missing actions/invariants. Shared native session-control semantics serve CLI, Board, Familiar and phone adapters.
items.dependencies: G2 foundation needs M01/M02 only. Board/artifact/Confluence action extensions are implemented with their owning G4/G5 services M08/M10/M13/M18; those extensions do not block the foundational action boundary.
items.risks: Retry after timeout/restart mutates twice; request ID reused with different input; receipt read error treated as absent; forbidden action bypass; STOP allows hidden restart.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose explicit versioned capabilities, stable actionable errors and consistent paused state; domain authorization independent of open UI.
acceptance: Same request+input produces one effect across timeout/restart; reused ID with changed input rejected; mutation and receipt commit together.
Denied/out-of-project/stale approval or question call causes zero mutation; unknown action never falls through.
STOP pauses control dispatch/queues; paused list/get/wait allowed, no implicit resume; preserve namespace-specific self-session protections.
CLI/MCP fixture fields/errors match; cancel/disconnect does not duplicate accepted work.

items.title: Jira Inbox hierarchy
items.status: Shipped custom hierarchy over common connector
items.native: Native Jira status/project/issues/details/thread/comments exist, but issue fields omit issuetype/parent and hierarchy metadata.
items.uniqueDelta: Epic/story/subtask hierarchy, cycle/orphan-safe projection, expand/flatten and selection behavior.
items.portability: Extend existing Rust adapter DTO/parsers; translate pure hierarchy projection and reuse native Inbox rows. Carry pending shared HTTP behavior, not just its file layout.
items.dependencies: M01/M02, account-scoped config; M21 HTTP safeguards.
items.risks: Missing parent drops issue; cycles hang UI; duplicate IDs across sites; stale old-account response replaces new results.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose stable hierarchy row IDs, account-scoped expansion cache, keyboard disclosure and type text beyond color.
acceptance: Epic/story/subtask, missing/self/cyclic parent and mixed-project fixtures retain every visible issue.
Expansion/selection survive refresh; keyboard search/navigation reaches children.
Loading/empty/auth/timeout/retry distinct; changed-account response discarded; credentials never follow unsafe redirect.

items.title: Confluence browser, context, app actions and connector MCP
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific integration
items.native: Native Jira and general MCP machinery exist; no corresponding Confluence browser/service or MOLFAR connectors-mcp endpoint found.
items.uniqueDelta: Space/page/folder tree, pagination/search/read, context mentions, hidden spaces, shared Atlassian configuration and CLI/MCP contracts (including existing Jira comment tool).
items.portability: Adapt Rust HTTP/parsing with explicit config/path service instead of AppHandle; native tree/reader/search UI; extend existing native entry points rather than copying Tauri app shell.
items.dependencies: M01/M11/M12; shared connector HTTP/error policy.
items.risks: Stale cache crosses accounts; incomplete pagination; content kind mismatch; MCP writes bypass capability boundary.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose one connector service for UI/CLI/MCP, account-keyed cache, cancellable search/stale-result rejection and explicit read/write capability discovery.
acceptance: Nested space/page/folder and pagination fixtures match; missing/unsupported content, invalid token and timeout recover.
Context preserves title/body/source URL; cancelled search cannot replace current selection; account disconnect clears cached pages.
MCP/action shapes and existing write behavior fixture-tested; credentials excluded from logs; reader/tree keyboard and empty/error states covered.

items.title: Obsidian / Knowledge vault, graph and revision editing
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific integration
items.native: Native file/editor/search/notes exist; no vault connection, backlink graph or equivalent revision-save service found.
items.uniqueDelta: Vault connection/scan/index, wiki/alias/relative links, graph, asset preview, add-to-context, cancellation and Companion vault API.
items.portability: Reuse Rust scanner/path/revision routines with explicit native IO; translate link resolver using existing fixtures; adapt native editor/markdown/list before graph interaction. No React/DOM transplant.
items.dependencies: M01/M02/M11, native files/editor and artifact-safe assets.
items.risks: Symlink escape, overwriting external note, stale disconnected scan result, concurrent scans, large graph blocks input.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose service-owned scan/cancel state, generation-stamped snapshots and bounded worker projections; accessible list alternative and reduced-motion graph.
acceptance: Two views share one scan; cancel/reconnect rejects stale output; external edit causes revision conflict.
No outside-vault read/write; encoded/relative/ambiguous/wiki links match fixtures; missing asset explicit.
Large-vault operation remains cancellable; keyboard list/reader and graph alternative available; empty/error/retry paths preserve source files.

items.title: Home dashboard and custom brand visuals
items.status: Shipped MOLFAR-specific surface
items.native: Native workspace/usage components exist; no equivalent custom ten-widget Home grid found.
items.uniqueDelta: Widget composition/layout persistence, recent sessions/automations/status and orb/fire/brand visual behavior.
items.portability: Port aggregation contracts to native service and build native widgets using semantic tokens; import saved intent/order, not CSS pixel geometry.
items.dependencies: M02/M04/M17/M16 and automation summaries.
items.risks: Invalid saved layout silently reset; decoration masks empty/error states; background animations consume resources or impair reduced-motion users.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose responsive native grid, consistent chart/card tokens, keyboard rearrangement and pause decorative work when hidden/reduced motion.
acceptance: Copied visible widget set/order retained or explicit recoverable mapping shown; source preference never overwritten on parse failure.
Empty/loading/partial/error cards show real state; navigation to session keeps selection.
Keyboard rearrange alternative works; all animation obeys reduced motion and hidden-window pause; benchmark before claiming smoother rendering.

items.title: Usage dashboard and additional provider sources
items.status: Shipped custom dashboard over common usage data
items.native: Native usage services/footer support multiple sources; generic usage is common. Dedicated MOLFAR Cursor/Antigravity dashboard paths are not equivalent to native subscription defaults.
items.uniqueDelta: Independent Claude/Codex/Cursor/Antigravity dashboard cards, normalized last-good/stale/error handling, history/trends.
items.portability: Reuse native sources where contracts match; adapt missing Rust fetch/parsing logic and existing fixtures; one refresh owner, no duplicate poller.
items.dependencies: M01/M02 and preference mapping; shared usage data precedes independent Home/Usage views. No dependency on M15.
items.risks: Unavailable rendered 0%; failure erases prior values; account switching shows old account usage; stale data displayed current.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose visible source/time/stale labels and independent refresh/error handling; consistent accessible chart summaries.
acceptance: All four shipped dashboard sources represented or explicit parity blocker recorded.
One failed refresh cannot erase other cards; last-good marked stale; missing values never fabricated.
Old-account response ignored; retry/cancellation/empty/limited states correct; chart meaning available without color/hover.

items.title: Custom settings, themes and saved defaults
items.status: Shipped; many controls already common native
items.native: Native themes/glass, paced reveal, autocorrect, remaining usage and email masking controls already exist.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR preference keys, palettes, saved defaults, new-layout opt-in policy and cross-window persistence. Do not duplicate common native controls.
items.portability: Explicit versioned import map; preserve explicit source values and use reviewed native defaults only for absent keys. Native layout need not recreate old opt-in toggle.
items.dependencies: M01/M02; copied web-storage export.
items.risks: False/missing conflated; autocorrect default differs; importing unsupported setting overwrites source; view ordering lost.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose previewable import report listing mapped/unsupported settings, shared tokens and clear reset scope.
acceptance: Explicit true/false/value imports match source and survive reload; missing and invalid values distinguished.
Unsupported keys retained in import manifest; no production storage access; failed write surfaced.
Settings search/keyboard/focus/reduced motion and high-contrast states verified later; absent defaults approved before adoption.

items.title: Document and HTML artifacts, cards and sandbox security
items.status: Shipped; common native artifact base plus MOLFAR metadata
items.native: Native notes content_kind/artifact_kind, Mono artifact actions and sandboxed macOS WKWebView exist. Linux/Windows HTML currently falls back to text.
items.uniqueDelta: MOLFAR provenance/card identity, retries/deletion/theme/size/open-link behavior; Board versioned handoff is distinct M10.
items.portability: Prefer native store and sandbox host; adapt metadata/contracts. Arbitrary interactive HTML cannot be replaced by native visual widgets without explicit behavior loss.
items.dependencies: M01/M02/M11 and platform HTML implementation before required-platform parity.
items.risks: Privileged app bridge/network/parent escape; forged resize/navigation; doc/HTML kind collision; platform text fallback loses functionality.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose validated artifact boundary, bounded resizing and explicit stale/deleted/unsupported states; accessible source fallback, never silently weaken isolation.
acceptance: Stable IDs/provenance survive reopen; retry updates one card; delete removes intended reference.
Malicious HTML cannot call app bridge, fetch network or access parent DOM; opener/height messages validated.
Keyboard focus can enter/exit; missing/corrupt content recoverable; required-platform HTML rendering or explicit approved scope waiver before release.

items.title: Companion HTTP/Tailscale gateway and BitChain compatibility
items.status: Shipped gateway; pending PR119 hardening
items.native: Native QUIC phone gateway exists but is not Companion v2 wire-compatible.
items.uniqueDelta: Default-off loopback/tailnet HTTP(S), hashed device tokens, BitChain pairing, Familiar/session STOP/approval/questions, Board and vault revision actions. BitChain client lives outside this repo.
items.portability: Adapt Rust gateway/auth/bounds with native service dispatch; both gateways use one authorized domain layer, not one transport implementation.
items.dependencies: M01/M02/M04-M11/M14 and M21 validation/config-corruption safeguards.
items.risks: Stale or forged replies; duplicated mutation after disconnect; accidental wildcard/WAN bind; token reuse across identities.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose explicit reachability/offline state, per-device revoke, versioned capability negotiation and consistent bounded errors.
acceptance: Companion v2 fixtures retain all shipped custom methods; revoked devices denied and secrets not logged.
STOP works while views hidden; stale/replayed approvals rejected; conflicts preserve vault/Board data.
Corrupt pairing store backed up with visible error; default-off/no wildcard behavior retained; pairing/cancel/offline UI accessible.
External BitChain client interoperability remains a later runtime gate, not inferred from server tests.

items.title: Pending QUIC phone app and mandatory no-UPnP policy
items.status: Pending PR117 mobile candidate; security decision mandatory
items.native: Native core has QUIC MobileHost, pairing/watch/capability handling and phone app; upstream open_router defaults true and router dependencies remain.
items.uniqueDelta: Pending MOLFAR Expo branding/project linkage and commit 118b5c1a89ab2737285bad00acaf0d3aa44355b6 explicitly removing automatic router mapping. Current main does not ship this mobile client.
items.portability: Reuse native mobile architecture/client; carry removal of router mapping/config/dependencies and add lockfile/config regression guard before any native runtime. Do not merely change default to false.
items.dependencies: M01 first; M11 domain layer; custom phone capabilities depend on migrated services; mobile distribution remains separate approval.
items.risks: Fresh native profile exposes router port; old config reenables mapping; 32 unpaired slots exhausted; external client capability mismatch.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose LAN/Tailscale/explicit reachability only, visible capability differences between gateways and bounded pairing/handshake resource tests. Handshake hardening is backlog unless separately implemented.
acceptance: Default/config/legacy fixtures never invoke router mapping; dependency/lockfile/source guard rejects igd-next/natpmp mapping restoration.
Pair/revoke/reconnect/watch/STOP fixtures preserve native behavior; no listeners start by importing data.
Pending client labeled candidate until devices/platform distribution tested; no EAS build/publish or account changes in setup.

items.title: Lifecycle, persistence, validation and hardening invariants
items.status: Pending PR119 remote; six additional local-only commits
items.native: Native runtime/store/error/platform owners exist, but different code paths; Tauri/React structures are not native fixes.
items.uniqueDelta: Pending snapshot-load write guard, settled/logged boot writes, input validation, corrupt-config backup, safe Git environment/remotes, MCP load errors, lock recovery, dependency fixes. Local-only Sidebar/transcript splits and Files-tab loop fix remain separate.
items.portability: Create per-invariant native owner/fixture map; preserve semantic fixes and native-appropriate recovery. Do not cherry-pick all React extractions, lockfiles or old dependency versions.
items.dependencies: All slices; M01 before runtime and M02 persistence boundary.
items.risks: Calling pending work shipped; assuming native already fixes bug because implementation differs; unread persisted layout overwritten by empty boot state.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose fail-closed persistence/error states, structured bounded diagnostics and deterministic event/timer tests. Refactor only when required by owned native behavior, without file-size targets.
acceptance: Snapshot load failure never overwrites unread stored layout; explicit successful recovery resumes writes.
Partial boot writes report each failure; corrupt settings retain backup; malformed phone input has zero side effects.
MCP failure is visible; inherited Git env cannot redirect repository; source-specific mutex recovery does not hide invalid state.
Native regression reproduces relevant failure then passes fix; local-only UI changes remain evidence, not resumed B7.

items.title: Backlog and optional improvements boundary
items.status: Not shipped parity: separate proposals only
items.native: Native orchestrator depends_on exists, but does not establish Board card dependency support; native UI has distinct capabilities.
items.uniqueDelta: Board card dependencies are explicitly out of scope in current Board spec. Companion full-text vault search and push notifications are unimplemented. Deferred global-refactor Stages6-10 are not product features to promise.
items.portability: Do not port non-existent behavior. Keep optional dependency graph/schema/cycle policy, phone search/push and major redesigns in separate plans after parity.
items.dependencies: Detailed product approval after G9; no task automatically enables backlog.
items.risks: Migration scope grows by treating wishlist as existing functionality; generic orchestration confused with persistent Board dependencies.
items.proposedImprovement: Propose later Board dependency design only if needed, with cycle/failure/cancel/recovery rules. Smoothness/visual improvements remain scoped to migrated slices.
acceptance: Inventory and release checklist clearly distinguish shipped, remote pending, local pending and backlog.
No Board dependsOn schema/dispatch or push/search capability advertised before its own approved implementation and tests.
